title: Verbs of Motion
intro: Russian has PAIRS of motion verbs: unidirectional (one direction, one trip) and multidirectional (round trips, habitual, or no specific direction). Идти means 'to go on foot in one direction right now.' Ходить means 'to go on foot regularly, round-trip, or in general.' Same distinction: ехать/ездить (by vehicle), лететь/летать (fly), плыть/плавать (swim), нести/носить (carry), вести/водить (lead). Master these pairs before adding prefixes!
rules: Unidirectional (идти, ехать): ONE direction, ONE specific trip, happening NOW: Я иду в школу. (I'm going to school right now.)
Multidirectional (ходить, ездить): ROUND TRIP, HABITUAL, or GENERAL ability: Я хожу в школу каждый день. (I go to school every day.)
Past unidirectional = was going (in progress): Я шёл домой. (I was walking home.)
Past multidirectional = went and returned, or habitual: Я ходил в магазин. (I went to the store and came back.)
examples: Куда ты идёшь? — Я иду на работу. (Where are you going? — I'm going to work., right now), one way
Ты часто ходишь в кино? (Do you often go to the movies?), habitual
Вчера я ходил к врачу. (Yesterday I went to the doctor.), round trip completed
Когда я шёл домой, я встретил друга. (When I was walking home, I met a friend.), in progress

items.prompt: Куда ты _____? - В магазин. (Where are you going? - To the store.)
items.promptEnglish: Where are you going right now?
items.hint: Going right now, one direction → unidirectional present
items.explanation: Current one-way motion uses unidirectional: идёшь.

items.prompt: Я каждый день _____ на работу на метро. (I go to work by metro every day.)
items.promptEnglish: I go to work by metro every day.
items.explanation: Regular habitual motion uses multidirectional: езжу.

items.prompt: Смотри! Самолёт _____! (Look! A plane is flying!)
items.hint: Specific plane moving in one direction now → unidirectional
items.explanation: Specific motion happening now uses unidirectional: летит.

items.prompt: Вчера я _____ в библиотеку. (Yesterday I went to the library and back.)
items.promptEnglish: Yesterday I went to the library.
items.hint: Went and returned (round trip) → multidirectional past
items.explanation: Completed round trip uses multidirectional past: ходил.

items.prompt: Когда я _____ домой, начался дождь. (When I was walking home, it started raining.)
items.promptEnglish: When I was walking home, it started raining.
items.hint: In progress, one direction → unidirectional past
items.explanation: Motion in progress (background) uses unidirectional past: шёл.

items.prompt: Птицы _____ на юг осенью. (Birds fly south in autumn.)
items.explanation: Movement in one specific direction uses unidirectional: летят.

items.prompt: Мой сын хорошо _____. (My son swims well.)
Посмотри, лодка _____ к берегу. (Look, the boat is sailing toward the shore.)
items.promptEnglish: Look, the boat is sailing toward the shore.
items.explanation: Specific directional motion now uses unidirectional: плывёт.

items.prompt: Летом мы часто _____ на море. (In summer we often go to the sea.)
items.promptEnglish: In summer we often go to the sea.
items.explanation: Habitual motion with 'часто' uses multidirectional: ездим.

blanks: — Ты умеешь плавать? — Да, я хорошо _____. (Yes, I swim well.)
Я каждый день _____ в школу пешком. (I walk to school every day.)
Смотри, мы сейчас _____ на работу. (Look, we are driving to work right now.)
fillInBlank.grammarFocus: General ability/habit uses multidirectional; right-now uses unidirectional
hints: General swimming ability (умеешь) — which motion verb type?
'Каждый день' means habitual — which type of motion verb?
'Сейчас' means right now, one direction — which motion verb?
explanations: General ability uses multidirectional: плаваю (I swim in general).
Habitual repeated trips use multidirectional: хожу (I go/walk regularly).
Right-now one-direction motion uses unidirectional: едем (we are driving now).

minimalPairs.context: Вчера я _____ в театр. (went there and back)
minimalPairs.contextEnglish: Yesterday I went to the theater.
minimalPairs.explanation: Round trip (went and returned) uses multidirectional: ходил.

minimalPairs.context: Вчера, когда я _____ в театр, я встретил Машу. (was on my way)
minimalPairs.contextEnglish: Yesterday, when I was going to the theater, I met Masha.
minimalPairs.explanation: In progress, one direction (was going) uses unidirectional: шёл.

explanations: Я иду (going now, one way) / я хожу (go regularly, round trip)
Они идут (going now, one way) / они ходят (go regularly, round trip)

reviewVocab.example: Иду в школу. Хожу каждый день.
Еду на работу. Езжу на метро.
